## Problem

What task is currently difficult or repetitive?

## Proposed outcome

Describe the result you would like to see, without prescribing an implementation unless it is important.

## Data source

If the feature needs game data, say where it can reliably come from: `Game.log`, local files, UEX, Star Citizen Wiki, OCR, or manual input.

## Alternatives considered

What other approach have you tried?
